_meta.description: Multimodal agent tool specification: the name, parameters, call format and return format of every tool.
_meta.coordinate_system: All coordinates are normalized to 0-1000 in xyxy order [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]. Points are [x, y].
_meta.image_id_system: ORIGINAL is the question's own image; IMG_001, IMG_002, ... are numbered in the order the <image> placeholders appear in the record.

tools.name: text_search
tools.description: Text web search; returns page titles, snippets and links.

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- text search result for [QUERY] ---
...
--- end text search result ---
</tool_response>
response_format.fields: A numbered list; each entry is [title](URL) followed by a snippet.

tools.name: text_search_image
tools.description: Text-to-image search; finds web images by keyword and returns image references.

top_k.description: How many images to return (1-10). Each image costs 1000+ context tokens, so ask only for what is needed.

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- image search result for [QUERY] ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
  title: ...
  url: ...
...
--- end image search result ---
</tool_response>
response_format.note: Each image is assigned an IMG_NNN id, numbered in the record's global <image> order.

tools.name: image_search
tools.description: Reverse image search; uploads the given image (optionally cropped to a bbox) and returns visually similar images with an evidence summary.

image_path.description: A local image path (optional when image_id is given).

boxes.description: A bbox normalized to 0-1000; the image is cropped to it before searching.

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- image-to-image search results ---
num_results: N
[1] ... evidence ...
[2] ...
--- end image-to-image search results ---
</tool_response>
fields: [N] each result carries a URL and an evidence summary.
response_format.note: The result images are processed internally by a VLM; what comes back is a textual evidence summary with no <image> tag.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Fetches a web page and extracts the information relevant to the query.

query.description: What to extract from the page.

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- browse result ---
url: ...
query: ...
fetch_method: ...
summary:
...
--- end browse result ---
</tool_response>
fields: summary: a summary of the extracted information.

tools.name: crop
tools.description: Crops a region out of an image and upscales it, to inspect detail.

boxes.description: A bbox normalized to 0-1000, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max].

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- crop result ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
source_image_id: ORIGINAL
--- end crop result ---
</tool_response>

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Draws rectangles on the original image to verify a bbox. Can be called repeatedly to refine.

boxes.description: A bbox normalized to 0-1000, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max].

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- verify result ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
source_image_id: ORIGINAL
--- end verify result ---
</tool_response>

tools.name: verify_part
tools.description: Crops the bbox region for a final check. Can be called repeatedly to refine.

boxes.description: A bbox normalized to 0-1000, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max].

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- verify_part result ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
source_image_id: ORIGINAL
--- end verify_part result ---
</tool_response>

tools.name: verify_mask
tools.description: Runs a local SAM3 with the proposed bbox plus optional positive/negative points, and returns an overlay visualisation of the resulting mask.

boxes.description: A bbox normalized to 0-1000, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max].

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- verify_mask result ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
source_image_id: ORIGINAL
--- end verify_mask result ---
</tool_response>
response_format.note: The returned image is a cyan overlay visualisation of the SAM3 mask.

tools.name: compare_lr
tools.description: Find-the-difference only: given a bbox on the left panel, returns that region and the same region of the right panel stitched side by side (separated by a magenta line) at identical size, for direct pixel-by-pixel comparison.

boxes.description: A bbox on the left panel, normalized to 0-1000, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]; x_max must be <= 500.

response_format.wrapper:
<tool_response>
--- compare_lr result ---
IMG_NNN: <image>
source_image_id: ORIGINAL
left_box: [...]
right_box: [...]
layout: left region | magenta divider | right region (same size)
--- end compare_lr result ---
</tool_response>

tools.name: python
tools.description: Executes Python code for arithmetic, coordinate transforms or image analysis.

response_format.wrapper_text_only:
<tool_response>
--- python result ---
{print output}
--- end python result ---
</tool_response>
response_format.wrapper_with_image:
<tool_response>
--- python result ---
{print output, or (no output)}
IMG_NNN: <image>
--- end python result ---
</tool_response>
fields: If _result_image is set, it is assigned an additional IMG_NNN.
response_format.has_image: conditional -- only when the code sets the _result_image variable.

pre_injected_variables.IMG_001..N: PIL.Image -- images returned by earlier tool calls.
pre_injected_variables.num_images: int -- how many IMG images already exist.

response_format.constraints: There must be output (print or _result_image); code that produces none is treated as invalid.

rules: Each turn is either a tool_call or an answer, never both.
When think is empty the <think> tag may be omitted and <tool_call> emitted directly.
Only one tool may be called per turn.
